svg.title: T14.1_LTE_Turbo_RTL_microarchitecture
svg.text: SISO datapath, alpha/beta memories, extrinsic RAM, interleaver address generation and CRC-gated iteration control.

text.tspan: Read soft buffer, place system/parity LLR
Hard decision, CB CRC, optional early

g.text: Key RTL Memories and Address Generators

text.tspan: 8 states x K columns per window
Two read paths for SISO, normalize per column
Two ping-pong banks indexed by pi/depi
One bank read, one bank write per half-iteration
f1/f2 polynomial address generator or ROM
Must align with SISO latency and stall
May stop after full iteration only
Fetch LLR, masks and interleaver context.
Hard decision and CB CRC after full iteration.

path.data-note: CRC fail and iter < max_iter（回环沿泳道下方绕行，不穿 SISO B / DONE-ERROR）

text.tspan: Size grows with K, states, quantized width and ping-pong banks.
Niter x two half-iterations x SISO cycles
CRC early stop changes average latency, not worst-case budget.
Pipeline and parallel windows improve throughput but increase SRAM ports.

Protocol evidence fixes K, interleaver parameters, tail bits, rate-recovery inputs and CRC boundaries. RTL choices such as window size, SRAM banking, early-stop policy, clock gating and reset sequencing are implementation strategy and must be
